payload.title: Redirects and URL stability
payload.description:
Keep every live URL or 301 it as data (existing aliases kept), with a before-and-after sitemap comparison using the PPY-bcfd2d parity method.
Scenario: No live URL is lost
  Given the sitemap and alias list before the change
  When the new site is built
  Then every old URL returns 200 or a 301 to its successor, and the new sitemap contains every canonical URL

Depends on: PPY-bcfd2d.
